Days you were online but did not claim stack (Monthly and 7-Day); they need a registered account

task: Spend boss keys (30 cap, +5 for each Engineer Keyring tier, up to 45)
why: Boss cards, pets and Enhance stones

task: Act 1 vendor: buy all the Enhance Stone 1 (3 a day; Engineer Vendor Stock raises it) and the Animal Bone
why: Stones for gear up to steel. Each bone crafts a Bone Dagger, a cheap item to fail on when building enhance chance

task: Act 2 vendor: buy all the Crystallized Yellow Substance and the Enhance Stone 2
why: The vendor is its only source. Thorium weapons take 140 each, the armor set 102, thorium tools 40 each, steel tools 10 each, and Wish for Gold uses it later

task: Act 3 vendor: buy all the Crystallized Blue Substance and the Enhance Stone 3
why: The vendor is its only source. Infinite 1 armor takes 60, and Perfect Silk Fabric and Perfect Aether Crystal use 3 and 6 a craft

task: If you bought Cost Cruncher: before any other Hunter purchase, buy your most expensive planned Hunter level
why: Needs at least one level of Hunter Cost Cruncher (300 gems). Any Hunter purchase uses up the whole stacked discount, so let the expensive one take it

task: Act 2 town: collect the Slyme from the egg
why: The egg hatches one every 16 hours; Slymes are pet food

task: Collect curio coins before they cap
why: Coins stop accruing at the cap

task: Run the event dungeons while an event is on
why: Trinkets and event rewards. Tiers are gated by attack (top tier 10M). Dungeon keys stack to 20, so a missed day is not lost

task: Log in and make the two daily donations (500k and 10m gold)
why: Activity, seals and guild funds. The weekly guild kill task needs playing, not only a login

task: Check the Hourglass rifts and start any that finished
why: Rifts run 8, 10, 12 or 20 hours and open at Hourglass level 5
